content.title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

sections.title: Periprocedural Management
details: Discussions around periprocedural anticoagulation management in patients with atrial fibrillation.
Nave guidelines on left atrial appendage (LAA) closure and its efficacy in stroke prevention are highlighted.

sections.title: AF Complicating ACS or PCI
details: Explores anticoagulant and antiplatelet therapy approaches during acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in patients with atrial fibrillation.
Emphasis on balancing thrombotic and bleeding risks.

sections.title: Chronic Coronary Disease (CCD)
details: Antithrombotic strategies for patients with stable coronary disease and atrial fibrillation are reviewed.
Rivaroxaban as monotherapy after PCI explored.

sections.title: Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD)
details: Vascular events and outcomes with novel oral anticoagulants for patients with atrial fibrillation discussed.
